A documented instance, on a pragmatic distinction, of two realizations equal under a standard probe family and different under an independently built one. An ML paper that neither record holds. | Active |
| [CASE-071](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-071.md) v2 | Metric bias in MBR decoding | Minimum Bayes risk and quality-estimation decoding pick, from 128 sampled translations, the one a neural metric scores best. That metric and other neural metrics rate the picks significantly better than greedy decoding; human MQM raters find them no better, and for four system and language-pair combinations significantly worse. [CASE-041](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-041.md)'s result in text, by selection rather than training. The distinction lost is accuracy, not a pragmatic one; a stipulated English-to-Russian ты/вы variant states the design that would make it pragmatic. | Active |
| [CASE-072](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-072.md) | Hafez's "Shirazi Turk" in English | The opening of Hafez's ghazal 3 names a beloved, "that Shirazi Turk", whose sex and nature the Persian leaves open. English forces a choice at the first possessive. Jones (1771) and Bell (1897) make the beloved a maid, Clarke (1891) makes it God, and Davis (2012) makes it a boy, and Davis says in print that his choice is arbitrary. A documented instance of the half of a change of cover in which the rendering decides what the source left open. The disagreement on the source is among translators and scholars; no reader agreement has been measured. | Active |
| [CASE-073](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-073.md) | The Kia Provo name | In March 2013 Kia showed a concept car at Geneva named the Provo, "from the word 'provoke'". Kia said it meant no offence, and withdrew the name for the UK and Ireland. One name, the speaker's intention fixed and declared, a new audience, and an unintended reading taken up and acted on: the accidental, verbal variant of [CASE-064](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-064.md), illustrating [CLAIM-224](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-224.md). | Active |

The owner judges it a better demonstration of a population with drift-diffusion decision dynamics than anarchy mode. Showing the tally adds feedback, and feedback moves the dynamics toward winner-take-all. | Active |
| [CASE-075](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-075.md) v2 | Twitch Plays Pokémon: anarchy mode | In February 2014 a stream let everyone in its chat play one copy of Pokémon Red at once, with every typed button press executed in turn. | [CASE-097](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-097.md) v2 | The castle topic across eigenmodes | Appendix H of Part III of the owner's LEGO monograph builds two co-occurrence matrices from nonnegative topics. One has topics for spaceship and castle; the other splits spaceship into wings and engines and keeps castle unchanged. The monograph reads castle's survival as a stable eigenmode and calls that archetype persistence. Computed here: the topics overlap (ship·castle = 0.21), so no eigenvector is the castle topic. The eigenvector closest to it is the second mode at rank 2 (cosine 0.873) and the first at rank 3 (0.926), about 51° apart. Persistence of a generating factor does not show as persistence of an eigenvector, which is what [CLAIM-148](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-148.md)'s identifiability limits predict. | Active |

| [CASE-099](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-099.md) v3 | Coupled model linearized at its symmetric state | A14 §2 of the exchange of 2026-10-16. Near the symmetric state of the two-hypothesis, two-specialist model, (m, a) evolves by a 2×2 matrix J = [[α, β], [γ, δ]] plus noise. With nonnegative entries and α, δ < 1, the symmetric state is unstable exactly when βγ > (1 − α)(1 − δ), and the unstable direction mixes meaning and authority. Checked here. A construction about a linearization, not a fitted or simulated result. | Active |

Stipulated; it shows no particular reputation was self-fulfilling. | Active |

A fanbase can have the second and third without the fourth, and a vocal minority can set a public stance most members privately reject. The case for [QUESTION-119](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-119.md). Stipulated. | Active |

| [CASE-106](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-106.md) v2 | Linearization with score-conferred authority | Built for [QUESTION-121](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-121.md)'s formal question: is scoring operators on predictions committed before the evidence equivalent to Regime B? The coupling γ then has the sign of κ′ − κ̄: corrective when the interpretation bends the predictions more than the reading of the evidence, null when equally, capturing when less. Checked symbolically, and the stability conditions against 200,000 random draws. Fictional by construction. | Active |
| [CASE-107](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-107.md) v3 | Locked-in syndrome | The owner's case, U2 of the exchange of 2026-10-16: "a lucid human who struggles with locked-in syndrome". It separates lucid judgement from limb and speech action. In the classic form it does not separate judgement from action as active inference defines it, since the eye movements it spares are that theory's model action. The completely locked-in state is the real test, and there any evidence of lucidity has to come through a channel that is itself an action. Visceromotor regulation and Damasio's internal 'as if body loop' survive paralysis, so the case never removes every contingency between intention and outcome. | Active |

Its sharpest variant compromises the processes that evaluate the others' competence, which tests [CLAIM-342](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-342.md)'s independent scoring. Federated learning is the natural testbed. Not run. | Active |

| [CASE-117](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-117.md) v7 | Emergent specialization in adaptive operators | The study proposed in the synthesis the owner relayed on 2026-10-18 for [QUESTION-083](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-083.md) and the questions filed with it. | [CASE-118](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-118.md) v5 | Two competing components with overlap ρ | From the synthesis the owner relayed on 2026-10-18, checked. The two-component Lotka–Volterra system with symmetric overlap ρ: invasion growth 1 − ρ equals λ_min(A), and κ(A) = (1 + ρ)/(1 − ρ), so overlap weakens recovery and ill-conditions the features together. Holding A fixed and setting r = (1 + δ, 1 − δ) gives the coexistence equilibrium n* = (1/(1 + ρ) ± δ/(1 − ρ)), feasible only when \|δ\| < (1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ). The same representation geometry supports coexistence under one supply and exclusion under another. | Active |

The construction says such relief is possible; whether specialization produces it is [QUESTION-133](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-133.md). | Active |

The majority held that this did not matter for the use at issue: a magazine cover illustrating a story about Prince serves substantially the photograph's own purpose, and new meaning counts only as evidence of a different purpose. A minimal model of thermal annealing in which the resource that pays for crossing barriers, temperature, also sets the free energies and barriers it pays for. Four states: U (unfolded), N (a nucleus, as in Schneider, Möritz and Dietz's compacted intermediate), F (the folded target) and M (a misfold trap). Each state and each transition state has an enthalpy and an entropy, so its free energy is linear in temperature, and rates are Arrhenius. Computed with python3 -I by matrix exponentials of the rate matrix. Reachability of the target within a time budget is a window in temperature, not an up-set, whether it is counted as the fraction folded at the horizon or as the chance of having reached the folded state by then; more time widens the window; a two-step schedule reaches what no constant temperature reaches in the same time. A's three designs (baseline, guided nucleation, competing early binding) share the target and yield 59.3, 76.2 and 29.6 %, checked with python3 -I. A notes that scaling α and β together leaves the first branch unchanged. The assistant adds that this holds only when both exits have the same molecularity. If entering the trap from N binds a further molecule and completing does not, a uniform increase of supply by λ gives P_F = α/(α+β) · γ/(γ+λδ), which falls from 59.3 % at λ = 1 to 19.0 % at λ = 20. The rates are A's invented illustrative parameters, not measurements. The model is A's; the extension is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |

| [CASE-315](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-315.md) v3 | Readiness simulator: spend-matching, carry-over | [LEAD-080](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-080.md) asked for A's simulator of [QUESTION-394](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-394.md) to be run twice, once with each month's budget set to the last month's peak spending ([CLAIM-577](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-577.md)) and once with carry-over, to see whether the heavy-rescue response of [CASE-213](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-213.md) stays reachable. Under spend-matching the squad is lost for good in every one of 300 runs, by a median of month 2 to 8, when it is sent only on confirmation or reports are few (two a month), and in 20 % of runs within nine years when it is sent provisionally to every one of six reports a month; drilling every month keeps it in every run. Rolling over the unspent part keeps it in every run; rolling over 60 % of it loses it as fast as spend-matching. [CASE-200](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-200.md)'s carry-over rule never loses it for good but, used every month, leaves it reachable in half the months. So the claim's prediction holds, and a quiet period turns out to mean a month in which nothing at all mobilizes the squad, not a month without a true need. The model is the assistant's and its rates are invented. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |

| [CASE-333](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-333.md) v2 | Eight coupled oscillators with displaced drive | [LEAD-098](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-098.md) asked for [CASE-179](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-179.md)'s study, with A12's arms, and for [QUESTION-063](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-063.md)'s interventions. Eight Stuart–Landau units on a ring with one chord, each edge carrying a phase-offset map, were run in the design's regimes. Under a shared drive, uncoupled and coupled networks both lock (phase-locking value 0.9985 and 0.9996) and their observed offsets glue (holonomy below 10⁻⁴), so timing and gluing cannot tell them apart. Displacing the drive of one member by π/2 moves the others by 0.2 per cent of that member's shift without coupling, 30 per cent at coupling 0.3 and 58 per cent at 1.0; a kick to one member reaches the others at 0.010 against 0.12 to 0.14. Withdrawing the drive leaves the coupled self-sustained network coherent (order 0.996) and the uncoupled one not (0.47). Long suppression of a reciprocally maintained capacity becomes atrophy, short suppression does not. Revision by consistency reaches coherence without improving prediction; revision checked against held-out kicks cuts the held-out error from 1.06–1.81 to 0.14–0.34. Without the coverage feedback there is no absorbing state, though lumpy budgets still sustain less competence the rarer the use. | [CASE-346](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-346.md) v2 | The self-protecting sentry, run | [LEAD-076](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-076.md) asked for [CASE-153](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-153.md)'s full design, with hidden state and the restriction of evidence, which [CASE-157](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-157.md)'s run and the toy in [CASE-153](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-153.md)'s note of 2026-11-04 did not have. A hidden world is dangerous for 150 steps, safe for 400 and dangerous for 100. Each step the agent inspects (accuracy 0.9, cost 0.05) or shelters (no observation), then protects (cost 1) or engages (cost 5 if dangerous). A sentry's authority g biases posture toward protection and, where evidence is restricted, blocks inspection. Over 1000 paired seeds per condition, the Bayesian baseline leaves protection about 3 steps after the switch. When authority is rewarded by the apparent success of protection and the sentry restricts inspection, no run leaves protection in 400 safe steps and 43 % of runs never even correct the belief. Restriction costs 99 [95, 103] units of needless protection more under success feedback than under independent evaluation. An independent audit lets 66 % of runs leave. A protected investigator corrects the belief within a median 6 steps, yet protection outlasts it in 87 % of runs, the regime [CASE-153](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-153.md) asked for. Every regime still protects when danger returns. The case's own check comes out against the authority state: under success feedback its update is the habit of protecting, and a habit of matched memory reproduces the responses to belief correction, authority reset and restored evidence. Only interventions on the evaluation tell the two apart. The phase boundary lies near sentry strength κ = 1.25–1.5 and moves with the assumed switching hazard. The model and its values are the assistant's. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |
| [CASE-362](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-362.md) v2 | Shared perspective in five trained populations | [CASE-145](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-145.md) run as [LEAD-087](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-087.md) asked, after its criterion was stated. Five interaction arms: none (correlated responses), conformity during training only (socially learned norms), unconditional conformity, enforcement by a referee, and disagreements checked against the world. Each also ran with and without a vote that enacts a collective action and learns from a collective reward. Some members' interpretation of one category was perturbed, with the world moving the same way (warranted) or not. Over 20 seeds, every population is structurally concordant, and only the interacting ones draw the perturbed members back; but unperturbed members take up at most 2% of the deviation, under the 5% stated in advance, so none passes cross-member dependence and none shares a perspective by either reading. The evidential condition ranks the arms as predicted (0.025 against 0.004 for conformity) below its stated 0.05, in five settings. Conformity passes the restorative condition, which therefore fails A4's test. The vote gives collective agency in every arm and its absence none, so the study gives no constructed instance of perspective without collective agency. A stipulated model, one size. In the model of Chen et al. ([LIT-1894](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1894.md)), in numpy: no SGD run reached the 6-gon. The 5-gon's dropped feature gets an exactly zero gradient from every sample, so SGD cannot move it at any setting. The 5⁺-gon is a live local minimum that SGD does not leave in 45,000 epochs. Sampling exp(−nL) under the N(0, 1) prior puts 5 → 6 at n ≈ 265–279 and 5 → 5⁺ at n ≈ 780. The first two steps of the chain have no crossing above n ≈ 1. Chen et al.'s NUTS likelihood carries a factor ½ that their formula's nL does not, so their sample size is twice these n; on that scale the sampled 5 → 6 is at about 530–560, consistent with their Fig. 2. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |

With no evidence on the minority block independent of the proposals, attack success in a world and in its relabelling (dissenters' and attackers' targets swapped) summed to 1 for every architecture.
